lines.beaver: 어제 대통령 연설 봤어? 통일 얘기 나왔잖아.
lines.beaver_en: Did you see the president's speech? He talked about unification.
lines.beaver_roman: eoje daetongnyeong yeonseol bwasseo? tongil yaegi nawatjana.
lines.learner: 응, 봤어. 분단된 지 벌써 70년이 넘었더라.
lines.en: Yeah, I saw it. It's already been over 70 years since the division.
lines.roman: eung, bwasseo. bundandoen ji beolsseo chilsimnyeoni neomeotdeora.

lines.beaver_en: What did the president say about unification?
lines.en: He said he'd build peace through diplomacy first.

lines.learner: 맞아. 그래서 외교관들 역할이 커질 것 같아.
lines.en: Right. So I think diplomats' roles will grow.
lines.roman: maja. geuraeseo oegyogwandeul yeokari keojil geot gata.

lines.learner: 응, 찬성해. 한번 노력해 볼 만하다고 생각해.
lines.en: Yes, I'm for it. I think it's worth trying.
lines.roman: eung, chanseonghae. hanbeon noryeokae bol manhadago saenggakae.

lines.beaver: 근데 돈도 많이 들고 어렵지 않을까?
lines.beaver_en: But won't it be costly and difficult?
lines.beaver_roman: geunde dondo mani deulgo eoryeopji aneulkka?
lines.learner: 어렵지만 같은 말을 쓴다는 공통점이 있잖아.
lines.en: It's hard, but we have the same language in common.
lines.roman: eoryeopjiman gateun mareul sseundaneun gongtongjeomi itjana.

lines.beaver: 그건 그래. 주변 나라들은 어떻게 생각할까?
lines.beaver_en: True. What would neighboring countries think?
lines.beaver_roman: geugeon geurae. jubyeon naradeureun eotteoke saenggakalkka?
lines.learner: 힘센 나라들이 영향을 줄 수도 있어.
lines.roman: himsen naradeuri yeonghyangeul jul sudo isseo.

lines.beaver_en: So that's why politics becomes more important.
lines.learner: 응, 정치가 안정돼야 외교도 잘할 수 있어.
lines.en: Yeah, politics must be stable for good diplomacy.
lines.roman: eung, jeongchiga anjeongdwaeya oegyodo jalhal su isseo.

lines.beaver: 정치랑 선거에 대해서도 더 얘기해 볼래?
lines.beaver_en: Want to talk more about politics and elections?
lines.beaver_roman: jeongchirang seongeoe daehaeseodo deo yaegihae bollae?
lines.learner: 좋아. 다음 선거 공약도 들어 볼 만해.
lines.en: Sure. The next election pledges are worth hearing too.
lines.roman: joa. daeum seongeo gongyakdo deureo bol manhae.

lines.beaver: 그럼 이번 주말에 토론회 같이 볼까?
lines.beaver_en: Then shall we watch the debate together this weekend?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom ibeon jumare toronhoe gachi bolkka?
lines.learner: 그래. 그 토론회는 볼 만할 거야.
lines.en: Sure. That debate will be worth watching.
lines.roman: geurae. geu toronhoeneun bol manhal geoya.

lines.beaver: 좋아. 끝나고 커피 마시면서 또 얘기하자.
lines.beaver_en: Great. Let's talk more over coffee afterward.
lines.beaver_roman: joa. kkeunnago keopi masimyeonseo tto yaegihaja.
lines.en: Okay, see you this weekend. I'll text you!
